requests.title: A production standing adult body, with head, hair and wardrobe that fit it

consumer.playerVisibleUse: The player's own character, standing in the room the title screen shows them.

requests.whyNeeded: Five production rooms are registered and painting. Not one person can be composed into any of them, so every character-bearing surface falls to a room with a name on it. This is the single asset that unblocks the most surfaces at once.

inventoryCheck.found: 46 released components, every one a development fixture. 35 banked pg-* candidates, unreleased and in no catalog generation. 05B and 05C are both empty.
inventoryCheck.shortfall: The banked candidate bodies are gray mannequins kept as structural reference, and their attachment anchors are recorded as non-authoritative (D-068). Releasing them would put a reference mannequin on a production plate, which is the substitution the production path exists to prevent.

generationRecipe: One adult body in a relaxed standing pose, facing the camera, whole figure inside the canvas with the feet clear of the bottom edge.
True transparency everywhere that is not the figure. No painted ground, no shadow baked into the alpha.
Neutral undergarment-level body so tops, bottoms and footwear composite over it; not a finished outfit.
Grounded semi-realistic illustrated rendering matching the style authority. Not photographic, not cartooned.
No face or hair painted into the body: the head and hair are separate components.
acceptanceCriteria: Magic bytes are PNG and the alpha channel carries real per-pixel transparency, not a matte.
Six named semantic anchors descend the body in order, with the garment hips at or below the pelvis root.
Composes with a released head, hair, top, bottom and footwear into a complete plan with no missing layer.
Human visual approval recorded separately from intake acceptance.

requests.title: A production seated adult body for a desk

consumer.playerVisibleUse: Somebody sitting at the desk in the shared staff workroom.

requests.whyNeeded: Every seat anchor on the production office fails closed. The proof surface names the anchor and the reason, which is honest and is not a picture of anyone working.

inventoryCheck.found: Seated art exists only as the two authored A01/B01 fixture figures and the dev-modular seated fixtures.
inventoryCheck.shortfall: Both are development fixtures and are forbidden on a production plate by the production office's own library filter.

generationRecipe: The same adult body seated, thighs level, lower legs vertical, seated at a work surface rather than lounging.
The seat itself is NOT in the picture: the room supplies the chair and the seat plane.
True transparency; no chair, no desk, no shadow in the alpha.
Same rendering language and same body family as the standing body it pairs with.
acceptanceCriteria: The pelvis root sits on the canvas where the seat plane contract expects it.
Pairs with the standing body as one body family, not two people.
Composes into a complete plan at the production office's seat anchor.

requests.title: Child and adolescent body morphology

consumer.playerVisibleUse: The character during the growing-up years.

requests.whyNeeded: The formative years are playable and every banked body is an adult. Until a child body exists the formative surfaces must stay empty of figures, because scaling an adult down produces a miniature adult rather than a child.

inventoryCheck.found: Nothing. Every banked and released body is adult proportioned.
inventoryCheck.shortfall: Child proportions are not an adult scaled down: head-to-body ratio, limb length and mass all differ, and a scaled adult reads as uncanny rather than young.

generationRecipe: Standing bodies at two ages that read clearly as different: roughly middle childhood and roughly mid-adolescence.
Age is carried by proportion — head-to-body ratio, limb length, shoulder width — not by shrinking an adult.
Ordinary everyday clothing appropriate to the age, nothing costumed.
True transparency; same rendering language as the adult bodies.
acceptanceCriteria: Placed beside the adult body at the same scene scale, the difference reads as age rather than distance.
Carries the same named semantic anchors so the same compositor places it.
Human visual approval that neither reads as an adult.
